entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Workload commands leave `%TEMP%\<random>\dotnet-sdk-advertising-temp` behind (hundreds of MB of nupkgs), never deleted #57162
  • [CI triage] Reported net10.0 MVC F# RuntimeCompilation 10.0.15 restore failure in build 1673454 #57161
  • [CI triage] CI Quality Investigator startup_failure with no jobs for PR 57103 #57160
  • [CI triage] Windows CI cannot restore Microsoft.Build.NoTargets in build 1680044 #57159
  • [CI triage] UpToDate_ArtifactsRelocated fails moving tmp1 on Windows #57158
  • `Octokit` failures need updated OneLoc task #57157
  • SDK 11.0.100: pack of a single-targeted PackAsTool web project leaves its static web assets out of the package, while the manifest still names them #57154
  • .NET 11 installer should abort installation if minimum hardware requirements are not met #57150
  • `dotnetup` slowing down PowerShell session start-up #57147
  • Multi-architecture container publishing truncates environment variable values containing colons #57146
  • CA2213 false positive with System.Threading.Lock in a disposal call chain #57136

Closed

  • [11.0 regression] dotnet test error: No devices are available for this project #57120
  • [aw] Upgrade available #57131
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-terminal-progress-resources: drift detected (#0) #57141
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-terminal-reporter: drift detected (#3) #57139
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-terminal-reporter: drift detected (#0) #57138
  • [vendored-sync] dotnet-test-terminal-targetframeworkparser: drift detected (#0) #57140
  • [GeneratedComInterface] Produces SYSLIB1051 in WinUI3 project even though I have DisableRuntimeMarshalling=true #51159

PullRequests

Created

  • Delete temp directories created by workload commands and the background advertising update #57163
  • Fix trailing conditional directives leaking at EOF #57156
  • Re-enable net46 compilation context test #57155
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Keep Web SDK browser tools local to their project #57153
    Servicing-approved
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Keep Web SDK browser tools local to their project #57152
    Servicing-approved
  • [release/11.0.1xx] Only select devices for test projects in dotnet test --solution #57151
    Servicing-consider
  • Support attribute text for stale-reference candidates #57149
  • File-based apps: extend directive parsing APIs #57148
    Area-run-file
  • Fingerprint Blazor WebAssembly startup script on publish #57145
  • Fix CA2213 false positive with System.Threading.Lock #57137
  • [automated] Update man pages #57133
  • [release/11.0.2xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #57132

Merged

  • Add dynamic generic-help parity guardrails and skill guidance #57103
  • Only select devices for test projects in dotnet test --solution #57142
  • Upgrade agentic workflows to gh-aw v1.2.2 #57144
  • Reconcile MTP terminal vendored sources with testfx 74be6a61 #57143
  • Run GenerateAssemblyInfo before XamlPreCompile #57100
  • Require sdk_dir in the Native AOT bridge #57119

Updated

  • Unify dotnetup repository requirements and install-spec resolution #56798
  • Plumb cancellation through CLI commands and add phased shutdown #56332
  • Collect copilot telemetry correlation - fixes #57104 #57106
    Area-Telemetry
  • Fix cancellation rollback and Run API stdin handling #56979
  • Report missing inputs for no-build single-file publishing #57111
    sdk-diagnostic-docs-needed
  • Escape literal output paths before forwarding to MSBuild #56972
    breaking-change
  • [dotnet watch] Use the selected device's RuntimeIdentifier when evaluating and building projects #56723
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #56869
  • Kill Windows watch process descendants during forced termination #57113
  • ReadyToRun: recompile when crossgen2 arguments change; map PublishReadyToRunInstructionSet #57127
  • dotnetup: stop Windows installer downgrades from turning into failed repairs #57016
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Check each referenced project once in dotnet format #57019
    Servicing-approved
  • Use proper Registry Lookup for 64 Bit Machines in `dotnetup` #57051
  • Skip shared projects in release property discovery #57117
  • Use a build-owned static asset for browser tools activation #56386
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #57118
